meta.title: Anxiety (GAD-7)
meta.subtitle: How often anxiety bothered you over the last 2 weeks.
meta.description: Seven questions about anxiety and worry. For each, mark how often the problem bothered you over the last two weeks. The 0–21 score helps you track change over time. GAD-7 (Spitzer et al., 2006) is free to use.
meta.disclaimer: This tool supports self-reflection and tracking change. It does not diagnose and does not replace a consultation with a professional.

consent.title: Consent and disclaimer
consent.body: I understand this is a self-reflection tool, not a clinical test, and I agree to store my results locally on this device.

interpretation.minimal: Anxiety over the last weeks was minimal.
interpretation.mild: Anxiety was noticeable but mild. It's worth watching how it changes over the coming weeks.
interpretation.moderate: Anxiety was clear and probably got in the way of daily life.
interpretation.severe: Anxiety was strong and most likely weighed heavily on daily life.

notice: A score of 10 or higher often means it's worth talking about anxiety with a psychologist, psychotherapist or doctor. The exercises in the app can support that, but they don't replace it. If you're thinking about harming yourself, contact a local crisis line or your emergency number.

items.gad7_01: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
items.gad7_02: Not being able to stop or control worrying
items.gad7_03: Worrying too much about different things
items.gad7_05: Being so restless that it's hard to sit still
